versions.changelog: 升级钩子生成逻辑：先提炼灵魂命题，不再直接套用反差/情绪/刺痛句式；新增灵魂创作链路（具体人物→未说出口的话→核心矛盾→书的独特解释→创作者立场→情绪入口→钩子表达→证据回收→结尾余震）；强化创作者立场，杜绝无主语摘要；新增五道灵魂测试；同步更新评分与自检标准；减少模板化表达。

- Initial release of the "douyin-book-seeding-video" skill for generating Douyin (抖音) book recommendation short video scripts.
- Provides a detailed, step-by-step template covering material verification, user purchase task analysis, hook selection, evidence design, narrative structure, voice/text/visual planning, vertical 9:16 storyboarding, and compliance checks.
- Focuses on evidence-driven, low-advertising-feel video planning to drive real user purchase decisions, following a standardized, reproducible process.
- Requires at least three types of user-supplied materials (e.g., book cover, catalog, sample pages, real usage experience) and marks any unverifiable data as "pending verification."
- Supports post-publish video performance analysis to diagnose issues (hook, evidence, pacing, etc.) and generate single-variable testing plans for ongoing optimization.
